pixel_description: Render only: top shows two long parallel dark steel I-girders spanning beyond frame left-right, with splice plates and rows of bolts on webs. Directly below girders sits transverse bearer frame of short I-beams perpendicular to girders, clamped via bolted brackets with vertical bolts and nuts metal-to-metal. Hanging from frame are four vertical elements in two pairs: left pair black cylinder left and bright coiled helix right; right pair coiled helix left and black cylinder right. Coils are helical support springs with top eyelets to frame beam and bottom eyelets to top face of mass. Black cylinders are viscous dashpots with top clevis to frame and bottom clevis to top face of mass. Critical part 500kg TMD mass 1.85Hz is drawn as ONE solid rectangular steel block, horizontally elongated, centered under frame, top face carries 4 connections (2 springs + 2 dampers near ends left-right), bottom face above cover with clear vertical stroke gap, no other blocks, floating or duplicated. Below mass are two flat rectangular tray panels shown hinged open outward as removable cover panel, with hinge hardware and small links, forming a split cover with gap to mass. Callouts: Bridge Deck Section to rear girder, Transverse Bearer Frame to cross beam, Tuned Steel Mass to block, Removable Cover Panel to lower tray, Viscous Dashpots to right black cylinder, Helical Support Springs leader ends on left black cylinder (damper) not a coil. No people, hands, numbers, scale bars. Overall shape is under-deck hung mass at midspan, consistent with concealed damping for 40m footbridge; close-up scale plausible, not many times too large/small.

regions.observed: label 'Helical Support Springs' with leader dot ending on black cylindrical viscous damper
regions.expected: Helical Support Springs label leader should end on coiled helical spring

comparison_with_previous: First review - no previous render to compare; evaluated against mechanism sketch and engineers' hand sketches.

deviations.measured: 2 long parallel girders in close-up midspan section ~3-4x visible frame length, clamp bolts connect frame below girders
deviations.expected: 1 deck assembly ~20x frame, full 40m, touching bolts
deviations.why: Only a midspan section is shown, not full 40m. Two girders are one deck. Load path deck-bolts-frame preserved in pixels.

deviations.measured: 3-4 transverse I-beams stacked as clamp sandwich; dampers/springs hang from lowest beam; cover hinged below with gap
deviations.expected: 2 bearer beams touching damper and cover
deviations.why: Extra members are clamp sandwich detail for bolted transverse bearers. Vertical load path frame to springs/dampers to mass preserved, cover below with clearance.

deviations.measured: dozens visible: horizontal splice bolts on girder webs plus vertical clamp bolts; clamp bolts ~0.043x frame in close-up
deviations.expected: 8+ HS bolts vertical ~0.01x frame touching deck
deviations.why: Mixed orientations are different functions (splice vs clamp). Count larger, size larger due to close-up perspective, but clamping metal-to-metal preserved.

deviations.measured: 2 bright coiled helices vertical, one per side, eyelet top to frame, eyelet bottom to mass top
deviations.why: 2 springs + 2 dashpots = 4 legs as in engineers sketches. Pixels are vertical, segmenter horizontal is wrong. Symmetric vertical support preserved.

deviations.measured: 2 black cylinders vertical, clevis top to frame, clevis bottom to mass top
deviations.expected: dashpots vertical touching frame and mass
deviations.why: Pixels show vertical orientation and connection both ends. Segmenter horizontal/apart claims are threshold errors. Damping load path intact.

deviations.measured: single rectangular block touched at top by 2 springs + 2 dampers via eyelets/clevises
deviations.why: Direct visible connection frame to mass. Segmenter apart claim false. Mass free to move vertically for tuning.

deviations.measured: 2 open tray panels below mass forming split cover ~1.1x mass in perspective, hinged with stroke gap to mass
deviations.why: Two panels are open halves of one removable cover assembly shown open for view. Gap provides +/-50mm stroke clearance. Concealment when closed retained.

s1_differences: Close-up midspan section shows only girder length near TMD not full 40m; frame shown as stacked clamp sandwich; springs 2 coils + 2 dashpots vs schematic symbols; cover shown as two open panels vs one closed box; Helical Support Springs callout leader ends on damper instead of spring. Parts, vertical connections frame-to-mass, orientations and concealed under-deck arrangement match sketch.
s2_feedback: Mass hangs vertically on 2 springs + 2 dashpots from bearer frame with clear stroke gap above open cover panels; deck-frame clamp, spring-mass and damper-mass load paths continuous with no interference or impossible assembly visible.
notes: Photorealistic render, not diagram/CAD wireframe. Segmenter touch/orientation flags are coarse threshold errors - springs/dampers are vertical and connected in pixels. Only annotation fault requiring fix is Helical Support Springs leader ending on damper. No people/scale objects to misjudge 40m context; close-up midspan section is appropriate.
